main entries open LAN and Internet directly with current browser help

independent network controls save and Done returns to the correct browser
unoccupied slots initially Open
host can turn its last player OFF and restore KEY0 without losing the room
optional Options saves one Scheme File and host rules; preview has only arena/wins
connected peer nicknames and shared ten-slot roster
successful manual LAN address saves
host can set explicit AI and Closed slots without disconnecting users
client cannot alter host slot setup
host and client choose colors directly with KEY0 on the player rows; no color menu
client OFF and KEY0 reassignment preserve the node connection
host override releases a player without disconnecting its node
players advance directly to the two-row original arena preview without a controls wizard
host arena choice propagates with identical illustrative preview pixels
client follows the host preview and cannot change or start it
Escape returns directly from arena to players; one Enter proceeds again
host starts both windows through automatic media loading and ready barrier
full confirmed simulation and compact two-player configuration match
exact engine Replay hash matches at the same committed tick
current in-game guide opens and returns to the paused battle for both roles
network preferences preserve local-game rules and client hosting preferences

backend: two native production game windows, process-local Cocoa NSEvents
limitations: Local loopback transport validation; no deployed WAN or physical device claims.
Audio is muted; screenshots capture the production 640x480 game render target.
Splash timing is checked separately; this harness uses --skip-intro.
